suggestions.description: Using const object with type derived from keyof is correct but could be more explicit with 'as const'
suggestions.after:
export const ErrorCodes = {
  MISSING_API_KEY: 'MISSING_API_KEY',
  MISSING_GITHUB_TOKEN: 'MISSING_GITHUB_TOKEN',
  INVALID_CONFIG: 'INVALID_CONFIG',
  PR_NOT_FOUND: 'PR_NOT_FOUND',
  FILE_NOT_FOUND: 'FILE_NOT_FOUND',
  GITHUB_API_ERROR: 'GITHUB_API_ERROR',
  RATE_LIMITED: 'RATE_LIMITED',
  AGENT_TIMEOUT: 'AGENT_TIMEOUT',
  AGENT_FAILED: 'AGENT_FAILED',
  STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_FAILED: 'STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_FAILED',
  RETRY_EXHAUSTED: 'RETRY_EXHAUSTED',
  VALIDATION_FAILED: 'VALIDATION_FAILED',
  UNKNOWN_ERROR: 'UNKNOWN_ERROR'
} as const;

// More explicit type that's already correct
export type ErrorCode = (typeof ErrorCodes)[keyof typeof ErrorCodes];
suggestions.benefits: Explicit 'as const' makes intent clear. TypeScript correctly infers literal string types. Enables autocomplete for error codes. No functional change but better clarity.

refactorings.summary: One minor modernization suggestion for ErrorCodes definition (low impact, clarity only). Overall code quality is excellent with comprehensive documentation and well-designed error handling patterns.

recommendations.description: Implement comprehensive test suite for CodeReviewOrchestrator and main.ts entry point. These are the most critical files with zero test coverage. Tests needed for orchestration flow, schema validation, error handling, and authentication validation. Recommend targeting 80%+ coverage.

Remove logging of API key substrings in main.ts (lines 103, 121). Never log any part of credentials - use logger.info('✓ Authenticated') instead. This is a security vulnerability that could expose keys in logs/dashboards.

Add test coverage for all subagent files (code-quality-analyzer.ts, test-coverage-analyzer.ts, refactoring-suggester.ts). Each agent needs tests for successful analysis, skill invocation tracking, and error handling when output is missing. Recommend 10+ tests per agent.

Implement validation tests for Zod schemas in src/types/analysis-results.ts. These schemas are critical for data integrity - test that valid data passes, invalid data fails, enums are enforced, and score ranges (0-100) are validated.

Add unit tests for error handling utilities (src/utils/error-handler.ts). Critical to test withRetry exponential backoff timing, withTimeout enforcement, and ReviewError thrown with correct error codes.

Extract argument validation and authentication validation logic from main.ts into separate functions. This improves readability, testability, and maintainability. main() would reduce from 345 to ~250 lines.

Improve error context when orchestrator schema validation fails. Currently truncates output to 500 chars which may hide important details. Store full output in debug logger while keeping user message concise.
Extract complex query processing logic from orchestrator.ts (lines 128-227) into dedicated private method. This reduces function complexity and improves testability.
Extract duplicate toJsonSchema utility function used in both analysis-results.ts and report-types.ts into shared src/utils/schema.ts module. Improves DRY principle.
Add model validation in CodeReviewOrchestrator constructor. Validate model against list of supported models to catch typos early. Create SUPPORTED_MODELS constant and throw informative error.
